### REQ-019: Restore reportingInterval and status-on-change reporting

## Requirement

Legacy rooms published status when `millis() - lastReportMessage_ > reportingInterval_ * 1000 || statusChanged_` (`src/room.cpp:447-453`). The migration reports on a fixed 60 s timer only:

- `Room::reportingInterval_` is parsed from JSON, persisted and echoed in config (`core/room.cpp:342, 276`) but **never used** — backend-configured cadence has no effect.
- `Room::statusChanged_` is set on encoder target changes, humidity changes and external temperature updates (`core/room.cpp:160, 205, 399`) but **never read** — those events no longer produce a prompt status message (e.g. a user turning the knob is invisible to the backend for up to 60 s).

Fix: in `Room::updateControl()` count control ticks against `reportingInterval_` and publish early when `statusChanged_` is set (respecting REQ-013's locking rules and REQ-018's "not in timer task" rule). Keep the device-level 60 s report or give `Thermo` its own interval, mirroring legacy `Thermo::Update()` (`src/thermo.cpp:248-254`). Alternatively — if fixed-cadence reporting is the intended new design — delete `reportingInterval_`/`statusChanged_` and remove the config key, and update `doc/MQTT.md`.

See finding F-7 in `doc/reports/2026-07-02_migration_code_review.md`.

## Notes

Semantics chosen firmware-side 2026-07-04 (Peter unavailable → sensible defaults, documented in `doc/MQTT.md` "Status reporting semantics"); backend team review requested. Device-level status stays on a fixed 60 s cadence via new `Thermo::sendDeviceStatus()`; rooms self-report.
